prompt.initial:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create exactly ONE finished Japanese editorial basketball thumbnail, landscape approximately 16:9, ideally 1536x864 or larger than 1000 pixels wide. This is a brand-new artwork for バスケまとめ.

Approved visual direction: the black-and-lime brush-and-ink sports thumbnail visible earlier in this conversation (B-culver-black-lime-v3.png) is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Use charcoal black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B dry brush strokes, warm ivory Japanese lettering, expressive hand-drawn ink hatching. Do not copy its player, its text, scores or names. Produce an unmistakable illustration, never photorealism.

REAL PERSON SUBJECT: Brandon Randolph / ブランドン・ランドルフ, the actual Chiba Jets player. The official portrait viewed immediately above from https://chibajets.jp/team/players/detail/id=26997?PlayerID=51000643 and its linked official portrait https://bleague.bl.kuroco-img.app/v=2026111012/files/user/roster/704/2026-27/51000643_01.jpg is APPEARANCE REFERENCE ONLY. Render his specific likeness with close scalp cornrows pulled backward, visible neat rows and central part, tapered sides, long oval face, medium-brown skin interpreted with ivory/gray ink highlights, defined cheekbones, straight eyebrows, almond eyes, broad straight nose, full lips, thin moustache and a distinct short pointed chin goatee. Tall lean athletic frame and long arms. Tattoos on his anatomical left arm represented by subtle ink texture. Do not invent a generic player and do not use the style reference's player. Do NOT paste or trace a photographic cutout.

Composition: put this single player prominently on the LEFT 43 percent, in an energetic low driving dribble, knees bent, torso leaning forward, face shown clearly in three-quarter view looking toward the right, one hand naturally controlling an orange basketball near his outer hip and the other bent naturally for balance. Mid-thigh crop is intentional; head, elbows, wrists, all fingers, and the entire ball must remain safely inside the canvas. Leave the RIGHT 53 percent for a clean typographic column. Use a few broad diagonal lime brush accents behind the player to express motion. No opposing player, no crowd, no scoreboard, no arena, no additional decorative props. His jersey is plain ivory with dark ink folds, no marks, no number, no team/sponsor names. Balance warm orange basketball against black/lime/ivory. Facial features must stay readable rather than filled with black.

Exact visible text, all Japanese spelled precisely and no additional text:
Top of right column, small brand line: 「バスケまとめ」
Next line, medium: 「2026.11.12｜B.PREMIER」
Main heading, very large bold Japanese with strong hierarchy: 「登録選手の」
Main heading below, largest lettering in lime: 「ベスト5」
Supporting text on right, clearly legible: 「本日の対戦クラブから」
Supporting text below: 「今季平均EFFで独自選出」
Supporting text in a clear ivory-outlined or lime rule separated block: 「出場確定ではありません」
Footer along bottom with generous padding, high contrast and clearly legible: 「イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ」

Meaning and constraints: the article is a PRE-GAME selection of registered players based on season-average EFF, limited to today's participating clubs. It is NOT results from the November 12 games and NOT confirmation of appearances. The illustrated real player was RANDOMLY chosen among names in the fixed article only as an example image, not singled out as today's top performer; do not print his name, stats, team name, jersey number, or any claim about his appearance or performance. This scene is a conceptual illustration, not recreation of an actual game or specific scoring play. No game scores or invented numbers. No team logo, league logo, sponsor mark, watermark, or official photo. The league name is plain typography only. Maintain a generous 4 percent safe margin for all text; do not overlap face or hands with words. Anatomically coherent hands with five fingers, normal arms and joints, no doubled limbs. Render the exact AI label and image disclaimer. Make it polished, confident, sparse, and easy to read at thumbnail size.
prompt.revision:
Edit the attached generated basketball thumbnail with ONE targeted layout correction only. Preserve the exact Japanese text, spelling, date, every line, colors, ink illustration style, the same real Brandon Randolph likeness (cornrows, long face, thin moustache, pointed goatee), pose, plain unbranded jersey, and all factual qualifiers.
The dribbling hand is too close to/cropped by the LEFT image boundary and the head is too close to the TOP. Make the entire foreground player and basketball approximately 10 percent smaller and translate slightly to the right and down within the left illustration area, so the FULL hand including all five fingertips, the FULL basketball, elbows, and ALL hair have a clear dark margin of at least 45 pixels inside the canvas. Keep a natural mid-thigh crop at bottom if needed. Ensure both hands are anatomically correct with five fingers each, no extra limbs. Preserve the face with the same likeness.
Also slightly reduce the headline size if necessary so every text character ends at least 45 pixels inside the right edge. Keep this same wide landscape approximately 16:9 composition and at least 1600 pixels wide. Do not add border or distort the aspect ratio. Extend only charcoal/brush background into the freed margins; no new objects, no new text.
Exact text must remain: バスケまとめ / 2026.11.12｜B.PREMIER / 登録選手の / ベスト5 / 本日の対戦クラブから / 今季平均EFFで独自選出 / 出場確定ではありません / イラスト（AI生成）｜イメージ.
No names, performance statistics, logos, jersey numbers, or official photographs.
